evidence.proves: JNI slots 220 and 221 require distinct UTF-16 and UTF-region callbacks
a game-specific persisted-store GetString return is required by resume, Continue and Rewired paths

limits: The released GetStringRegion16 callback widens bytes and is ASCII-only; its implementation is not promoted.
SharedPreferences.getAll is diagnostic-only and has no handler in this release.
The working resume fix patches one game-specific RVA and remains adapter-owned.

evidence.proves: canonical UTF-16 storage, code-unit length, overflow-safe region copy and distinct JNI slots

limits: Object handles, exception creation and vtable installation are adapter-specific and are not promoted.

evidence.proves: getAll returns a fresh map rather than one process-global reused collection

limits: The backing store serializes values as strings and does not prove six-family typed fake-JNI dispatch.
No trace proves that this getAll method was exercised physically.

validation_observations.provenance: Bomb Chicken 1.1.6 community report and release validation
validation_observations.observation: same-session managed caching masked the persisted GetString defect; persistence acceptance must kill the old PID and read in a new PID before any write
validation_observations.limits: This observation is not claimed as a fact proved by the pinned source lines or by the nxandroid host gate.
